cs.content: Student získá znalosti a dovednosti o půdním prostředí, významu živin pro pěstované rostliny a vlivu půdních vlastností na rostliny, o vlastnostech a zásadách správného použití minerálních a statkových hnojiv a o zásadách správného hnojení zahradnických rostlin.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Student receives these knowledge and skills about soil milieu in the vegetable-growing, vineyard and orchard, about importance of nutrients for these cultures and the influence of soil properties on yield and quality of plant production, - about principles of application of mineral and organic fertilizers and about principles of precise fertilization of vegetable, vineyard and orchard.

en.content: 1.Agrochemical soil properties (allowance 2/2)2.Characterization of solid, liquid and gaseous soil phase, mineral and organic soil content (allowance 2/2)3.Nutrients in soil and their changes, soil sorptions, macroelements and microelements (allowance 3/3)4.Soil reaction, soil microorganisms (allowance 1/1)5.Mineral and organic fertilizers (allowance 2/2)6.Liming, soil salinity (allowance 1/1)7.Mixing of fertilizers, date and technique of application (allowance 1/1)8.Chemical composition of plants (allowance 3/3)9.Nutrient uptake and transport in plants, foliar application (allowance 3/3)10.Importance of plant nutrients, symptoms of their surplus and deficiency (allowance 2/2)11.Nutrition and fertilization of vegetables, fruits and grapevine (allowance 4/4)
